{{Quote|It's a gas giant - no life-forms.|[[Shara Jenn|Watcher Two]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Artus Five''' was a lifeless [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Artus system]] of the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Following the destruction of [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']], [[Darth Jadus]] faked his death and choose the orbit of Artus Five as a place to hide his secret dreadnought.
